stores.name: Apple Certified Refurbished
stores.note: Check the available model, included accessories and warranty on Apple’s listing.

stores.name: Dell Outlet
stores.note: Read the listed condition: refurbished, previously ordered new and scratch-and-dent are different.

stores.name: eBay Refurbished
stores.note: Check the seller, refurbishment grade and item-specific warranty.

stores.name: Amazon Renewed
stores.note: Check Renewed eligibility, seller and the guarantee shown on the product page.

stores.name: Reebelo
stores.note: Check battery options, cosmetic grade, seller and any additional fees.

stores.name: Back Market
stores.note: Compare cosmetic grade, battery specification and seller terms.

stores.name: Green Gadgets
stores.note: Read the listed condition and battery specification before ordering.

stores.name: Cash Converters
stores.note: Inspect listing photos and confirm condition, included accessories and delivery.

stores.name: EB Games Preowned
stores.note: Confirm whether the item is preowned or refurbished and which controller and cables are included.
